name: Feasibility: Addons — dev and testing
description:
Owners per PRD: Addons team, API team, DevRel team. This area carries the clearest efficiency win — on average 20% of API team capacity goes to partner support (API duty), part of which the portal would eliminate.

h2. Scope in PRD

- Step-by-step development guide (request → contract → development → testing → deployment)
- Deployment form (submission for review)
- Automated sandbox creation
- Sandbox API access activation (form → Salesforce)
- Form for test environment extension requests (iFrame, blank mode, endpoints)

h2. To analyse

- Automated sandbox creation — is there an API/automation path today, what would it take
- Secure token handling in the deployment submission form (PRD names token security risk and repeated credential leaks)
- Add-ons repository integration with GitHub — scope and method (OQ-15)
- Which parts of API duty the portal can actually remove (logs, statuses, docs availability)
- Final add-on review stays out of scope — portal allows submission only

h2. Output

Systems involved, integration gaps, T-shirt size, blockers, MVP / later / out-of-scope recommendation.
